title: 1 Chronicles Bible Quiz - Chapter 18
description: Ten questions on 1 Chronicles 18: David's victories over the Philistines, Moab, Zobah, Syria and Edom, and the officials of his kingdom.

questions.text: Which city with its towns did David take out of the hand of the Philistines?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 18:1 says David took Gath and its towns out of the hand of the Philistines.

questions.text: Of which place was Hadadezer king?
questions.explanation: Verse 3 calls him Hadadezer king of Zobah.

questions.text: What did David do with the chariot horses he took from Hadadezer?
questions.explanation: David hamstrung all the chariot horses, but reserved of them enough for one hundred chariots.

answers.text: He gave them all to Tou king of Hamath
He sacrificed them all to Yahweh at Jerusalem
He hamstrung them but kept enough for one hundred chariots
He sent them all back to Hadadezer king of Zobah

questions.text: What did David take from the servants of Hadadezer and bring to Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadadezer and brought them to Jerusalem.

questions.text: What did Solomon later make from the bronze David took from Tibhath and Cun?
questions.explanation: With that bronze Solomon made the bronze sea, the pillars and the vessels of bronze.

answers.text: The bronze sea, the pillars and the vessels of bronze
A bronze serpent on a tall pole
Bronze gates and bars for the walls of Jerusalem
Armor and shields for the whole army

questions.text: Whom did Tou king of Hamath send to greet and bless King David?
questions.explanation: Tou sent Hadoram his son to king David to greet him and bless him, with vessels of gold, silver and bronze.

questions.text: Where did Abishai the son of Zeruiah strike eighteen thousand Edomites?
questions.explanation: Verse 12 says Abishai struck eighteen thousand of the Edomites in the Valley of Salt.

questions.text: What did David execute for all his people as he reigned over all Israel?
questions.explanation: Verse 14 says David reigned over all Israel and executed justice and righteousness for all his people.

questions.text: Who was scribe in David's kingdom?
Who was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites?
questions.explanation: Verse 17 says Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites.
